text: The Drought‑focused Government Risk Financing initiative in New Zealand (2020–2025) is embedded within a broader climate risk governance framework. It focuses on enhancing climate risk transparency through the climate‑related disclosures regime overseen by the Financial Markets Authority (FMA). This approach aims to improve the financial system's ability to identify, price, and finance climate hazards, including drought, while aligning with international climate finance commitments and public health early warning systems.
